name: The Teal Spillway Cliffs
core_rationale: Northern sea-cliff cataract of Verdigris Siphon at [1, 0] where excess turquoise coolant plunges over oxidized brass weirs toward a hidden submarine cove.

mystery_hook.unanswered_question: Where does the northern Teal Spillway canal empty once the weir gate is raised?
